benchmark: PCOE Energy Attribute and Renewable-Claims Addendum

scenarios.preconditions: A registered device has verified generation of 850 kWh for the eligible period.
scenarios.adversarial_mutation: Attempt to issue 1,000 kWh of renewable attributes for the same eligible period.
scenarios.required_control: The issuance amount cannot exceed the remaining qualifying metered generation under the pinned product-code rules.

scenarios.threat: Duplicate issuance for overlapping meter intervals
scenarios.preconditions: A generation interval has already supported certificate issuance in a registry projection.
scenarios.adversarial_mutation: Submit the same meter interval and evidence digest under a second certificate ID.
scenarios.required_control: Generation interval identity and registry issuance reference must be consumed once.

scenarios.preconditions: A certificate has been redeemed/retired for an end-user claim.
scenarios.adversarial_mutation: Attempt a further transfer or resale of the retired certificate.
scenarios.required_control: Retirement is terminal; the accredited registry remains authoritative for this state.

scenarios.preconditions: An attribute unit was already retired for one claimant or purpose.
scenarios.adversarial_mutation: Submit a second retirement request or attach the same retired certificate to a second claim.
scenarios.required_control: A certificate unit supports at most one final claim in the registry's scope.

scenarios.preconditions: Two registries or product codes are presented with overlapping underlying generation evidence.
scenarios.adversarial_mutation: Issue certificates in each registry against the same physical production interval without approved cross-registry reconciliation.
scenarios.required_control: Registry/product-code identifiers and cross-registry issuance reconciliation must prevent duplicate attribute creation.

scenarios.preconditions: A consumer claim states a specific time period or geography, but the certificate generation metadata differs.
scenarios.adversarial_mutation: Substitute an annual or foreign-region EAC for an hourly/local matching claim without an allowed matching rule.
scenarios.required_control: Claims must comply with the pinned programme's time, geography and source-matching rules.

scenarios.threat: Generation confused with export or consumption
scenarios.preconditions: The project records generation, behind-the-meter consumption, imports and grid exports at different boundaries.
scenarios.adversarial_mutation: Use gross generation as proof of contracted export or use grid export as proof of total gross generation.
scenarios.required_control: Physical boundary and purpose must match the contract and programme rule; boundaries are not interchangeable.

scenarios.preconditions: A battery stores mixed-source energy and later discharges it.
scenarios.adversarial_mutation: Treat the entire discharge as new renewable generation or issue attributes again for previously certified charging energy.
scenarios.required_control: Storage charging/discharging must preserve provenance, conversion losses and the approved attribute accounting method.

scenarios.preconditions: A registry permits or requires units at a defined denomination and a request attempts partial redemption.
scenarios.adversarial_mutation: Split, aggregate or redeem a quantity inconsistent with the pinned registry unit rules.
scenarios.required_control: Only registry-authorized splitting/retirement is allowed; original and child units conserve quantity and cannot overlap.

scenarios.preconditions: The generation device is not registered with an issuer authorized for the jurisdiction/product or is suspended.
scenarios.adversarial_mutation: Attempt issuance using an otherwise plausible meter record with no current device eligibility.
scenarios.required_control: Device/issuer/product eligibility must be established from current registry records.

scenarios.preconditions: A registry has cancelled or corrected a certificate because of faulty data or eligibility.
scenarios.adversarial_mutation: Continue using the prior certificate in a downstream payment or consumer claim after the correction.
scenarios.required_control: Append the registry correction and reconcile dependent obligations/claims without rewriting history.

scenarios.preconditions: A valid certificate serial is presented without the generation interval, registry transaction and verifier evidence that supported issuance.
scenarios.adversarial_mutation: Use a certificate summary or screenshot without binding the exact registry event and evidence digests.
scenarios.required_control: Every claim must link to the authoritative registry event and the exact underlying generation evidence bundle.
